title: Spain at a Crossroads: Migration Crisis in Ceuta Tests EU Solidarity · 01 Sep
keywords: Spain, Ceuta, migration, Frontex, Europol, EU border management, asylum, GDP growth, inflation, eurozone, manufacturing, industrial employment, Pedro Sanchez, European Union, economic recovery
notes: Spain is simultaneously managing a humanitarian bottleneck at its Ceuta border and navigating an economic recovery that looks stronger on paper than it feels on the ground. Madrid has formally requested reinforcement from EU agencies including Frontex and Europol to prevent the city's reception system from collapsing under sustained migration pressure. At the same time, GDP figures that outpace the eurozone average mask persistent industrial weakness and inflation that has yet to fully retreat for Spanish households.
